apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Targets the measured post-decode presentation gap: live HUD showed 99 decoded FPS vs 73 displayed FPS, 5.9 ms decode, 0% packet loss, Metal 4 and MetalFX active. Removes fixed next-vblank present(at:) scheduling, retains scoped Metal 4 barriers, and bypasses MetalFX if either drawable dimension is within 18% of source size. Native Metal 4 HDR conversion remains; Metal 4 stays opt-in. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner. Renderer eligibility tests passed; the full 193-test suite had 191 passes, one skip, and two unrelated existing failures (iPad settings UI lookup and legacy frame-generation preference expectation). Physical iPhone retest is required; this is a targeted fix candidate, not yet confirmed.
